packageRules.description: actual-server must never outrun jhonderson/actual-http-api (which bundles @actual-app/api and syncs against the server's schema). The server's tag is driven by the actualbudget-lockstep customManager below, keyed to the API image's release feed, so both bump together in one PR. Disable the direct dep so the generic image manager doesn't propose the server independently.

actualbudget-lockstep: jhonderson/actual-http-api publishes API-only patch tags (e.g. 26.10.1) that have no matching actualbudget/actual-server tag, so the lockstep would propose a nonexistent server image (ImagePullBackOff + Recreate = outage, 2026-11-08). Only follow X.Y.0 releases, which both images publish.

headscale (ansible/inventory/group_vars/headscale.yaml): GitHub tags are vX.Y.Z but the var holds the bare version used in the .deb URL, so strip the v. headscale only supports upgrading one minor at a time (and each minor has breaking config/policy changes), so propose every minor as its own PR.
Emby: odd minor versions (4.9, 4.11, ...) are beta builds; stay on stable even minors.
Ceph: x.0/x.1 releases are dev/RC; only offer stable x.2.z.
CNPG ClusterImageCatalog entries are digest-pinned per PG major; the regex manager only bumps the tag (not the digest), producing misleading PRs. Clusters set imageName directly.

cloudflare provider: 5.23.0-5.25.0 fail plan on cloudflare_email_routing_settings (Value Conversion Error: struct field support_subaddress not in object); 5.26.0+ breaks apply with modified_on 'inconsistent result' (cloudflare/terraform-provider-cloudflare#7387) and the include_shadow_metadata PUT on Email Routing records (#7396). Lift once fixed.

customManagers.description: actualbudget-lockstep: resolve an `image:` tag against a different image's release feed. Used to peg actualbudget/actual-server to the tags jhonderson/actual-http-api actually publishes, so the server can never be ahead of the API client's bundled schema.
